SIGNATURE MOMENT: Section 3 (Apex Division team grid) features a massive typographic stunt — the rank numeral "#1" for Team VORTEX is rendered at approximately 160px in Archivo Black, ALL CAPS, in Neonrift Cyan (#00F5FF), bleeding behind the card content as a watermark-scale background glyph. This oversized numeral treatment cascades at decreasing opacity across the top cards, creating a data-overlay aesthetic that reads like a live HUD readout. This is unmistakably cyberpunk — numbers as visual architecture, not just data — and it anchors the most important section of the page with a typographic gesture that no other aesthetic would produce.

SECTION SEQUENCE & RHYTHM:
The page opens with a full-bleed, texture-heavy page header (Section 1) that is dense and aggressive — maximum visual impact, minimal whitespace. Section 2 immediately shifts to a compact, side-tabbed stats panel with horizontal scanline dividers — sparse, data-dense, terminal-like. Section 3 explodes into the signature card grid with oversized rank numerals bleeding behind cards — maximum density and visual drama. Section 4 drops to a tighter 2×2 grid with division-colored badge chips, slightly more restrained but still edgy. Section 5 closes with a full-bleed diagonal-cut CTA panel in Rift Magenta (#FF0080) — a saturated color block that breaks the dark surface rhythm and acts as a hard visual stop.

COLOR & SURFACE LOGIC:
- Sections 1, 3, 4: Void Black (#0A0A0F) base with Grid Steel (#1C1C2E) card surfaces
- Section 2: Grid Steel (#1C1C2E) full-width panel — one step up from Void Black to signal a data/stats context
- Section 5: Rift Magenta (#FF0080) full-bleed panel — the only warm-saturated background on the page, used deliberately to signal urgency and conversion
- Neonrift Cyan (#00F5FF) dominates headings and stat numbers throughout
- Acid Circuit (#AAFF00) used exclusively for eyebrow labels (Press Start 2P), live/status badges, and scanline decorative elements
- Plasma Violet (#7B00FF) used as gradient overlay on card backgrounds and as the division badge color for Apex
- Deadzone Charcoal (#2E2E42) used for card hover overlays, muted metadata, and disabled-state elements

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
- H1 display (Section 1 headline): Archivo Black, ALL CAPS, ~72–80px, tight tracking (−0.05em), Neonrift Cyan
- H2 section headlines: Archivo Black, ALL CAPS, ~48–56px, tracking −0.04em, Datastream White with key word in Neonrift Cyan or Rift Magenta
- H3 card titles: Archivo Bold, ALL CAPS, ~20–22px, Datastream White
- Eyebrows: Press Start 2P, 9–10px, letter-spacing 0.12em, Acid Circuit (#AAFF00)
- Body/descriptions: IBM Plex Mono Regular, 14–15px, 1.65 line-height, Datastream White
- Stat numbers: IBM Plex Mono Medium or Archivo Black, large scale (24–32px for inline stats), Neonrift Cyan
- Metadata/badge chips: Press Start 2P, 9px, Acid Circuit or Rift Magenta on Deadzone Charcoal pill backgrounds

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:
The page is intentionally high-density — this is a cyberpunk tournament roster, not a marketing brochure. Sections 1 and 3 are the most packed. Section 2 uses controlled whitespace as a "breathing terminal" between the header and the card grids. Section 4 is moderately dense. Section 5 uses generous padding to let the CTA breathe inside the aggressive Rift Magenta block — the contrast between the color intensity and the spatial openness creates tension.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
- Desktop (≥1280px): 4-column grid for Section 3, 2-column for Section 4, full-width stats row for Section 2
- Tablet (768–1279px): 2-column grid for Sections 3 and 4, stats stack vertically in Section 2
- Mobile (<768px): Single column throughout, oversized rank numerals scale down to ~80px but remain visible behind cards, Section 5 CTA buttons stack vertically

DIAGONAL PANEL DEVICE:
A diagonal cut (−3deg skew) is applied to the bottom edge of Section 1 and the top edge of Section 5, reinforcing the cyberpunk diagonal-panel visual cue. Scanline pattern overlays (thin horizontal rules at 2px height, 6px gap, 4% opacity in Acid Circuit) appear on Section 1 background and Section 5 background as a recurring texture motif.

SHARED DESIGN SYSTEM INTEGRATION:
All fonts, colors, and spacing tokens are drawn from the shared design system. The card grid layout family is expressed through modular, reusable team cards with consistent stat badges, division chips, and hover glow states (Neonrift Cyan box-shadow at 0 0 12px). The page sits in the site rhythm as page 2 — it inherits the brand identity established on the Home page and feeds into the Schedule page, so the CTA in Section 5 explicitly bridges to match viewing.",
